project.name: Samitt.com
project.summary: Proof Software's studio site (Proof LLC) at proofsoftware.co (samitt.co redirects to it) — a single-page Next.js marketing site for founders and execs with a product to build, with case-study pages and a Resend-backed contact form.

goals: Win consulting engagements for Proof Software through the contact form
Show what the studio has shipped — keep Work and the case studies current and credible

manual: Before merging: tick each 'Needs manual check' box on the PR, or strike it with a reason. On an integration branch, roll per-PR preview checks into the launch PR
Open the Vercel preview (or npm run dev) and eyeball the changed sections at desktop and phone width
If the contact form or /api/contact changed: submit a real test message on the preview and confirm it arrives in Gmail with reply-to set

risk_focus: Contact form delivery: /api/contact must keep sending via Resend from jeff@samitt.co (until #59 moves the sender to proofsoftware.co) to jsamitt@gmail.com with reply-to set, and every failure must both show the visitor the error with the studio's email link (hello@proofsoftware.co) and push an ntfy alert to Jeff. A failure that reports success, or the honeypot catching a real visitor (it returns a fake success), is a lead lost with no alert.

RESEND_API_KEY, NTFY_TOPIC and NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID live in Vercel env vars; changes must never hardcode, log or expose the Resend key or the ntfy topic (the topic is the secret: anyone who knows it can read the alerts) client-side or in logs. Alerts carry the visitor's name and email only, never the message, company or timeline.

Contact form abuse: protection is a contact_ref honeypot, server-side type/length/email checks, and a Vercel firewall rule (5 POSTs per 60s per IP, set in the dashboard, not code). Changes must not widen any of these, must never rename the honeypot to something autofill recognises, and should consider spam burning Resend quota or getting the sending domain flagged.
Every push to main deploys straight to production on Vercel with no staging gate; a change that builds but renders broken, or breaks metadata/OG image/sitemap/robots, goes live immediately.

Keyboard and screen-reader use: designs drawn on the canvas omit focus styles, heading semantics and focus movement, so every interactive change must keep visible focus (ink, never accent), real headings, and focus that lands somewhere sensible after content appears, disappears or is disabled.

rules: Marigold (accent) is only ever a fill behind ink text, never a text colour on light backgrounds — it measures 1.7:1 on page and is unreadable
Outline form fields with the field token, never rule — rule is 1.35:1 against page and invisible as a control boundary

Use the role tokens (page, surface, band, ink, ink-muted, rule, field, accent, on-dark…) for colour; no raw hex or Tailwind palette colours (white/10, gray-400) in components. Legacy navy/teal/mint tokens are for unmigrated code only
Headings and figures use font-display (Bricolage Grotesque); body text uses font-body (Figtree)
Layout must work at phone width with no horizontal scroll

steps.name: Vercel auto-deploys main — wait for its Production deployment to succeed (read from GitHub; stops on failure or after 8 minutes, so run it with a 10-minute tool timeout)
